name: Newsletter Cleanup
description: Reviews six months of Gmail newsletter traffic, sorts it into three categories in a local review.html file, and only cancels the subscriptions you tick off. Your mail stays where it is — nothing is deleted, so the inbox itself still needs a separate tidy.

official.title: Newsletter Cleanup by Andrej
official.description: Audits Gmail newsletters (last 6 months), builds a three-bucket review.html, then unsubscribes only what you approve. Never deletes mail.
